x: Jimmy Wood was in fine form and all but sang one of his Brighton songs through the megaphone. The rail strike kept all the Herne Hill team away and a number of our own runners.

Jimmy Wood and Len Herbert were winners of the Surrey mile and 3 miles with a number of places gained in the field events. The Juniors showed equal success with Derek Burfitt and Arthur Bruce winning the Middlesex and Surrey miles respectively.
Jimmy Wood, our Poly. member, caught and passed him but Len managed to hang on to 2nd place and handed over to Albert Frost who did well in putting up the fastest time for that leg.
